{"findings":[{"location":"source.html and translation.html, poem stanza 3, final two lines","severity":"major","source_quote":"God has not promised smooth roads and wide,
Swift, easy travel, needing no guide;
Never a mountain rocky and steep,
Never a river turbid and deep.","suggested_fix":"将最后两行改为“祂并未应许绝无崎岖陡峭的山岭，\n也未应许绝无浑浊深邃的河流。”这样保留前文“上帝并未应许”的语境，不会误说上帝应许旅途中不会有山岭或河流。","translation_quote":"上帝并未应许道路平坦宽阔，
旅途迅捷轻松，无需向导；
